```
Qxf7#
```

```
Smothered Mate
R5rk/6pp/7N/8/8/8/8/4K3 w - - 0 1
Nf7#
```

```
Arabian Mate
7k/8/5N2/8/8/8/8/4K2R w - - 0 1
Rh7#
```

```
Queen and Knight Mate
7k/8/4N3/8/8/2Q5/8/4K3 w - - 0 1
Qg7#
```

```
Ladder Mate (Two Rooks)
7k/R6P/8/8/8/8/8/4K1R1 w - - 0 1
Ra8#
```

```
Epaulette Mate
3rkr2/8/8/8/8/8/8/4QK2 w - - 0 1
Qe7#
```

```
Boden's Mate
1nkr4/pp1p4/B2B4/8/8/8/8/4K3 w - - 0 1
Bxb7#
```

```
Hook Mate
6k1/5pNp/8/8/8/8/8/4K2R w - - 0 1
Rh8#
```

```
Anastasia's Mate
8/4N1pk/5B2/8/8/8/8/4K2R w - - 0 1
Rh8#
```
